title: Part 1 : 2023: Bulk Handling Equipment-Hydraulic Excavator-Data Sheet for Selection - Part 1 Hoe
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers requirements of data required for selection of hydraulic excavator with hoe attachment and having diesel engine as the prime mover. 1.2 This standard does not apply to barge mounted excavator.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
